description: Hourly Electricity Generation, Demand, Load Shedding, and Fuel Mix Dataset for Bangladesh (2015–2026) is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Md Ibrahim Shekh, Rakibul Hasan Rafi (Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology). This dataset contains hourly electricity statistics for Bangladesh, compiled from the Power Grid Company of Bangladesh (PGCB) public ERP portal by running a custom Python script. It covers the period from April 2015 to March 2026, consisting of approximately 92,000+ hourly records. Coverage: national (BD); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
